articles.title: Donald Trump says oil execs have made too much money since blockade of Hormuz Strait
articles.description: As a consequence of the Iran war and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, oil prices have soared. With the midterm elections just three months away, he's potentially concerned about growing anger among Americans. Story by Charlotte Hughes and France 2.

articles.title: DR Congo is set to open its largest ever Ebola treatment facility

Officials hope the expanded treatment capacity will strengthen response efforts and improve care for patients as the outbreak continues to spread.
